name: Instrument On DataNMesh
description: Instrument Data on DataMesh - Publishing Pipeline

purpose.description: To provide AWM teams with a standardized way to access Instrument Reference Data through DataMesh.
objectives: Publish Instrument Reference Data on DataMesh
Eliminate bespoke integrations across AWM teams
Implement an automated data publishing pipeline

value.description: The project aims to centralize access to Instrument Reference Data, improving data discovery and efficiency.
benefits: Consistent data access across AWM teams
metrics: Reduction in time spent on bespoke integrations
Increase in user satisfaction with data access

outcomes.description: A standardized source for Instrument Reference Data accessible through DataMesh was established.
successCriteria: Successful publication of Instrument data to DataMesh
Increased usage of the federated data catalog
measurableResults: Number of consumers accessing Instrument Reference Data

technologies.name: AWS S3
technologies.description: Cloud storage service used to hold parquet files containing Instrument reference data.

technologies.name: AWS Glue
technologies.description: Managed ETL service used to process parquet files and create data partitions based on business requirements.

technologies.name: Amazon EventBridge
technologies.description: Serverless event bus that triggers AWS Glue jobs upon the arrival of new data.

technologies.name: AWS Lambda
technologies.description: Serverless compute service used to implement partition logic for processing data.

approach.description: Implement an automated pipeline to publish instrument data to DataMesh.

plan.name: Automated Data Publishing Pipeline
plan.description: A daily pipeline that publishes Instrument reference data, ensuring high availability and standardization.

methods.name: Data Ingestion and Processing
methods.description: Automate the ingestion of data and its processing for downstream applications.
steps: Trigger pipeline daily upon data availability
Generate parquet files with Instrument reference data
Process data using AWS Glue to create partitions

tools.name: AWS Glue
tools.description: Used for data transformation and processing.

tools.name: Amazon EventBridge
tools.description: Triggers workflows based on incoming data.

team.name: Asset & Wealth Management Team
team.description: Team responsible for implementing the project within JPMorgan Chase.

roles.name: Lead Software Engineer
roles.description: Responsible for leading the project and implementing technical solutions.

responsibilities.description: Lead the implementation of the automated pipeline
